name: tasks.md
description: Self-hosted, Markdown file based task management board

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npm run --silent setup && npm run dev:all
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && CONFIG_DIR=../config TASKS_DIR=../tasks node server.js
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.serve: rm -rf backend/static && cp -r frontend/dist backend/static && cd backend && CONFIG_DIR=../config TASKS_DIR=../tasks PORT=8080 BASE_PATH=/ node server.js
